content: A person is a person only through other persons.
author: African Proverbs
sourceWork: Umuntu ngumuntu ngabantu — Zulu & Xhosa Ubuntu Philosophy
explanation: We do not arrive in this world as isolated islands of self-contained ego. Our language, our capacity for empathy, our safety, and our moral growth are woven from the community that holds us. When you diminish the dignity of another, you diminish your own humanity.
practicalInsight: Look at every person you pass today not as a competitor or obstacle, but as a living mirror through whom your own humanity is reflected.
reflectionPrompt: How would your daily choices shift if you truly believed that your well-being is inseparable from the well-being of those around you?
